explanation: Maps each corpus source to its primary-source-anchored URL (SEC EDGAR / company registry / about-page). Use this in chrome to surface PRIMARY chips next to source names. When a source is mapped via funding_graph.outlet_to_owner, the URL is the parent company's SEC filing or registry. When not in the map (corpus sources not yet covered), we fall back to the source's own RSS/about URL as best-effort.
